notes.title: Version 1.6 - New Classes, Achievements, Bug fixes and Cards.
notes.content:
[u][b]New Classes[/b][/u]

New Class: Shaman. A being who has mastered the primal forces of nature. Specializes in the four elements. Plays with enemies resistances and weaknesses. Unlocked by beating the abyss with a Mage.

New Class: Martial Artist: A disciplined warrior that uses its fists. Cannot equip weapons. Specializes in stances. Uses Favor and Insight. Unlocks by defeating The Abyss as a Cleric.

New Class: Grand Shaman: Advanced Form of the Shaman. Can transform elemental resistances into weaknesses. Grants you All Shaman Powers and Trick Nature, that transforms elemental resistances into weaknesses at Combat Start

New Class: Stance Master: A Martial Artist that found True Focus. Can select two stances per turn and use Weapons. Grants the ability to use different stances with Passive Efects in Combat. Can equip weapons and select two stances per turn.


[u][b]New achievements[/b][/u]

Beat the Abyss with Shaman, Beat the End with Shaman, Beat the Abyss with Martial Artist, Beat the End with Martial Artist.


[u][b]Bug fixes[/b][/u]

Fixed an issue where the game would load for a lot after ending a run and loading the main menu again.
Floating text in combat is now independent of combat speed for better readibility.
Fixed translation error in Transmute Potion, Shop and Poison Cloud+
Fixed bug that made you receive Counter damage when Immune (Phaseshift Potion for example)

[u][b]New Cards[/b][/u]

Nature Pact - Removes enemies resistances at the start of combat (Aura).
Elemental Mastery - Bolt spells do more damage and cost no actions. (Bolt spells are: Chaos Bolt, Dark Bolt, Dark Bolt+, Earth Bolt, Fire Ball, Fire Ball+, Ice Bolt, Ice Bolt+, Lightning Bolt, Lightning Bolt+, Thrice Ice, Fire Ball++, Ice Bolt++, Lightning Bolt++) (Aura)
Elemental Bolt - Deals X damage. Element is the same as your last bolt played spell. If no element, deals half damage.
Elemental Bolt+ -  Deals X damage. Element is the same as your last bolt played spell. If no element, deals half damage.
Phantom Guard - You are immune to counters (Aura)
Trick Nature - Converts enemies resistances to weaknesses at Combat Start (Aura)
Inner Focus - Deals X Burn and Poison to everyone, effect applied twice to you. Amount of stacks scales with Spirit.
Jab - Deals X damage. If in Meditation Stance, grants 1 Favor and Element becomes Holy. Damage scales with Spirit/Attack (Whichever is Higher) and Dex.
Spinning Kick - Deals X to all enemies. Damage scales with Dex and Whirlwind Stance Stacks.

notes.title: Version 1.51 - Gameplay and UI Changes.
notes.content:
[b]Gameplay Changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Removed the "Super Combat" node.
[*] Removed the Growing Rights perks. These perks previously provided 2x more experience. A default 1.8x experience multiplier is now applied at the start of each run, regardless of perks.
[*] Removed the Exploration Tower, Abyss, and Fog Dissipation perks. Players can now advance to new floors without restrictions. However, the End perk still remains and is required to reach the true ending.
[*] Significantly buffed two-handed weapons: Assassin's Bow, Charge Bow, Practice Bow, Rudra Bow, Wooden Bow, Berserker Sword, Forgotten Sin, Staff of Neverending Winter, and Staff of the Three Arts.
[*] Increased Basic Attack base damage from 3 to 4.
[*] Increased Basic Attack+ base damage from 5 to 6.
[*] Rune Sword has been upgraded to Epic rarity, now provides the Earth Shatter card, and has been significantly buffed (MATK increased from 10 to 75, ATK increased from 0 to 75).
[*] Staff of Neverending Winter has been upgraded from Common to Rare rarity.
[*] Lucky Card has been upgraded from Uncommon to Epic rarity.
[/list]
[b]
Aesthetic Changes:
[/b]
[list]
[*] Updated booster images and fonts.
[*] Refreshed all perk sprites.
[*] Updated several equipment sprites.
[*] Modified fonts in the navigation bar.
[*] Aligned map level descriptions for better readability.
[*] Removed the "Legend" label below the map.
[*] Changed a lot of colors so they are more readable.
[*] Changed main menu.
[*] Changed map sprite and level font.
[/list]

tags.balance_change: - Removed the Growing Rights perks. These perks previously provided 2x more experience. A default 1.8x experience multiplier is now applied at the start of each run, regardless of perks.

- Removed the Exploration Tower, Abyss, and Fog Dissipation perks. Players can now advance to new floors without restrictions. However, the End perk still remains and is required to reach the true ending.
- Significantly buffed two-handed weapons: Assassin's Bow, Charge Bow, Practice Bow, Rudra Bow, Wooden Bow, Berserker Sword, Forgotten Sin, Staff of Neverending Winter, and Staff of the Three Arts.
- Increased Basic Attack base damage from 3 to 4.
- Increased Basic Attack+ base damage from 5 to 6.
- Rune Sword has been upgraded to Epic rarity, now provides the Earth Shatter card, and has been significantly buffed (MATK increased from 10 to 75, ATK increased from 0 to 75).
- Staff of Neverending Winter has been upgraded from Common to Rare rarity.
- Lucky Card has been upgraded from Uncommon to Epic rarity.

notes.title: Version 1.43 - Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Changes
notes.content:
Version 1.43 - Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Changes

Fixed a bug that prevented class selection if the ESC key was pressed on the class selection screen.
Enlarged the next and previous page arrows in the Deck Manager and added a shimmer effect for better visibility.
Corrected the displayed number of cards given in the Booster's tooltip description.
The 'Blessing of the Thunder God' effect now stacks with more than one aura stack.
The 'Mizuchi Sword' has been nerfed and now grants fewer 'Counter Stance' cards.
Revised ambiguous texts in the Card Selector related to equipping or unequipping equipment.
The Utility Belt now provides deck points instead of deck slots.
In the Deck Manager, 'Slots in deck' has been replaced with 'Cards in deck' and it no longer displays 'X/999', but simply 'X'.
Removed references to 'Slots' in the Inventory and End Game Statistics screens.
Modified perk descriptions to no longer mention card slots (Note: This change may require a new save file to take effect and will only apply to new players).
